title: HKUST Firebird CTF Competition 2024
description:
The competition will be online and will be conducted in the jeopardy style. The questions will include (but not limited to) the following topics: Binary Exploitations, Reverse Engineering, Web Exploitations, Cryptography, Computer Forensics and Miscellaneous. More details will be available in the competition web in January.

We are proud to have H3C and Huawei to be our sponsors
prizes:
Gold Prize : 10,000 HKD
Silver Prizes x 2 :  6,000 HKD each
Bronze Prizes x 3: 1,000 HKD
